authorization: User explicitly authorized redoing and replacing the original primary experiments before these runs.
data: Zenodo 12588635 common_voice_corpus1; all available US/England/Indian clips after official split filtering; no result-based filtering
private_auxiliary_split: GroupShuffleSplit(client_id, test_size=0.25, random_state=seed); preserve official development/test
accountant: Opacus PRV; record actual Poisson sample rate and complete history; utterance-level add/remove adjacency
balanced_softmax_counts: auxiliary labels only, clamp each count to at least 1
optimizer: AdamW, learning rate 0.001, weight decay 0.0001 for teacher and student
mel: 40 bins, first 100 frames, 16kHz, per-frequency mean/std normalization (eta=1e-5)
ssl: facebook/wav2vec2-base revision 0b5b8e868dd84f03fd87d01f9c4ff0f080fecfe8; frozen encoder; final-layer mean pooling; mono 16kHz first 12 seconds; full float32; linear head teacher and student
pairing: same teacher checkpoint, seed+1000003 student initialization, seed+1000004 auxiliary ordering; same architecture within family
HAKD: temperature-scaled teacher probabilities weighted by development true-class recalls; no mean normalization of KL weights
CTKD: published global temperature 1+20 sigmoid(u), u0=1; negative cosine-ramped temperature gradient over 10 epochs; matched AdamW speech protocol
checkpoint_selection: maximum development Macro-F1, earliest tie; no test-driven hyperparameter or branch selection
T-BAcc: Hard if teacher development balanced accuracy <0.45, otherwise KD; a newly declared binary comparator, not a recovered historical threshold
student_selection_baselines: S-BAcc, S-MF1, S-Maj select among Hard/KD/HAKD on development only; ties ordered Hard,KD,HAKD
reporting: all seeds and all noise settings; sample SD; paired gains; route choices; no replacement of unfavorable runs; main plots use exactly the table run pool
